gulucaptain-best-paper-writing-skill-bes.description: Draft or rewrite the title, Abstract, Introduction, Method and Experiments of an ML/CV paper in the style of CVPR/ICCV/NeurIPS best papers, distilled from 60 award papers, and plan and draw its figures (Figure 1, method overview, result figures) with award-paper layout and style. Use when the user either (A) fills in the intake form (assets/intake_form.html JSON) or describes problem, idea, method and results, or (B) pastes an existing abstract (or abstract plus introduction) to make it more convincing. Can write directly into a LaTeX template such as the CVPR author kit. Not for related-work…
